<function name="GetVelocity" parent="CMoveData" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Gets the players velocity.

<bug issue="3413">This will return Vector(0,0,0) sometimes when walking on props.</bug>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Vector">The players velocity</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints the player's velocity.</description>
	<code>
function GM:Move( ply, movedata )
    print( movedata:GetVelocity() )
end
	</code>

</example>
